title: Check the Transport for NSW benefits available for pensioners
summary: Find out about concessions and discounts on transport services and products for eligible pensioners in NSW.

Holders of an interstate pensioner concession card are not eligible.
what_you_need: Proof of eligible pension from Services Australia or the Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA).

external_links.text: Concessions and discounts for licence-related fees

faqs.q: Who is eligible for these concessions?
faqs.a: You must be a NSW resident with an eligible pension from Services Australia or the Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA). Note that holders of an interstate pensioner concession card are not eligible.

faqs.q: What types of products and services can I get concessions for?
faqs.a: Concessions are available for items such as licences, driving tests, riding skills tests, Photo Cards, and NSW Mobility Parking Permits.

faqs.q: Where can I find more savings and discounts?
faqs.a: You can find information on vehicle registration concessions for pensioners, concessions for licence-related fees, and support services for seniors, carers, and pensioners.
